authority: T0 finite-lattice common-container certificate; not a TECT action, theorem-tier change, completed CP1, physical vacuum, or Pre-A closure
statement: On every finite periodic cubic lattice of side N divisible by four, the local real-scalar Hamiltonian with B_i=-S_i-S_i^{-1}, positive inertia, positive stiffness and positive onsite quartic coupling has exactly eight isolated quadratic nodes. For r<0 its classical energy admits an exact same-Hamiltonian complete-square comparison: the global minimum is -N^3 r^2/(4g), strictly below the zero-field configuration, and the 256 minimizers are exactly the constant-magnitude fields in the common stencil kernel. The node sector is closed under cubic reciprocal-lattice Umklapp. For every fixed N and fixed parameter tuple, the quantum Hamiltonian on the infinite-dimensional Hilbert space L2(R^(N^3)) is a confining Schrodinger operator with one unique positive ground state under standard prior-art theorems, but that state is symmetry invariant and does not select one classical pattern. Translation-invariant parent data cannot deterministically select a proper nonempty site boundary. Thus the construction repairs the common finite algebra, Hamiltonian and classical reference ledger only partially: it supplies no characteristic-boundary map, PA-H1 derivation, physical cooling history or CP1 closure.
verdict: ADVANCE THE EXACT LOCAL LATTICE ORDERING AND COMMON-REFERENCE SCAFFOLD; REJECT CP1 COMPLETION AT THE CHARACTERISTIC-BOUNDARY AND PHYSICAL-HISTORY GATES

parent_definition.lattice: Lambda_N=(Z/NZ)^3, N=4m, m>=1, lattice spacing a=1, V=N^3
parent_definition.classical_phase_space: R^V_phi direct-sum R^V_pi with sigma((phi,pi),(phi_prime,pi_prime))=sum_x(phi_x pi_prime_x-pi_x phi_prime_x)
parent_definition.quantum_representation: the regular irreducible Weyl CCR representation on L2(R^V,dphi), with no finite occupation compression
parent_definition.hamiltonian: H_r=sum_x pi_x^2/(2chi)+1/2 sum_x[r phi_x^2+c sum_i(B_i phi)_x^2]+g/4 sum_x phi_x^4
parent_definition.parameters: c>0, g>0, chi>0, hbar>0, r real
parent_definition.boundary_condition: periodic spatial boundary condition; not a null, characteristic or event-horizon boundary
parent_definition.field_normalization: one real coordinate per site, lattice-cell factor one

exact_classical_theorem.nodes: Q_sigma=(sigma_1 pi/2,sigma_2 pi/2,sigma_3 pi/2), sigma_i in {+1,-1}
exact_classical_theorem.global_flow: finite-data Hamilton flow is global because energy is conserved and finite-N sublevel sets are compact
exact_classical_theorem.r_nonnegative: phi=pi=0 is the unique stationary point and global minimizer
exact_classical_theorem.r_negative_minimizers: pi=0, B_i phi=0 and phi_x^2=-r/g at every site
exact_classical_theorem.ordered_hessian: c sum_i B_i^2-2r I with spectral floor -2r>0
exact_classical_theorem.star_order: V^(-1) sum_Q |phi_hat(Q)|^2=-r/g on every minimizer in the declared unitary DFT convention

umklapp_and_alias_boundary.exact_closure: Q+Q+Q is in the eight-node set modulo the reciprocal lattice and 3Q=-Q for every N divisible by four
umklapp_and_alias_boundary.exact_comparator: sqrt(2) cos(Q.x+pi/4) is a sign field and attains -Vr^2/(4g)
umklapp_and_alias_boundary.reason: the exact closure and coefficients are reciprocal-lattice Umklapp facts and do not inherit the continuum PA-M2 cosine moment 3/8
umklapp_and_alias_boundary.uv_removal_status: not proved; at fixed lattice spacing N growth is a volume limit, while a->0 sends the pi/(2a) nodes to the ultraviolet unless a separate staggered continuum reduction is derived

critical_dynamics.inserted_time_law: Hamiltonian inertia chi; it is part of the candidate and is not derived from static order
critical_dynamics.global_harmonic_bound: for r>0 the gradient exists and |grad_k omega|<=2 sqrt(c/chi) at every k; for r=0 the bound holds off the nodes and omega is globally Lipschitz with the same directional-speed envelope

boundary_selection_no_go.statement: A deterministic translation-covariant rule applied only to the translation-invariant finite Hamiltonian and its unique ground state cannot select a proper nonempty site subset on the transitive torus.
boundary_selection_no_go.proof: the selected subset must be invariant under every translation, and the translation action has one site orbit, so the subset is empty or full
boundary_selection_no_go.boundary: this excludes only proper site-subset selection from the symmetric fixed-N data; it does not exclude state-conditioned sectors, relational boundaries, time-dependent characteristic sheets, gravity or a larger parent
